cognitive.$description: Primitive values for cognitive-accessibility mode — larger touch targets, enhanced readability, reduced visual complexity. Structure ported from finance; grounded in WCAG 2.2 Target Size (AAA) and cognitive-accessibility best practices.

touchTargetMin.$description: Minimum interactive touch/click target — WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced, AAA).

focusRingWidth.$description: Enhanced focus-ring width for improved visibility (default is 2px).

focusRingOffset.$description: Enhanced focus-ring offset for improved visibility (default is 2px).

borderWidth.$description: Enhanced border width for clearer element-boundary definition.

maxChoicesPerGroup.$description: Maximum options presented in a single group/menu — Miller's Law (7±2) with a conservative bound for cognitive-load reduction.
